arbol.vacioTexto: Once you add divisions, areas or sub-areas, the org chart will appear here.
arbol.sinTiposActivos: There are no active unit types.

fecha.titulo: View the org chart on a date
fecha.ayuda: Shows the organization as it was on that day, read-only. Type it or pick it; days highlighted with a dot had changes. Leave it empty to go back to today.
fecha.sinCambios: No changes were recorded that day.
fecha.masCambios: And {n} more change. | And {n} more changes.
fecha.panelSoloLectura: Data for the chosen date: read only. Go back to today to edit.
fecha.dialogoSoloLectura: Position as of {fecha}: read only. Go back to today in the tree to edit.

arbol.verEquipo: View {n} person in {unidad} (not counting sub-units) | View {n} people in {unidad} (not counting sub-units)
arbol.buscarAtajo: Search unit or person: its name, or the name or email of someone with a position in it (F)

vista.rutaPorTipo: Show on cards the parent unit of type
vista.activaVerPuestos: Turn on “Show positions” to see the legend colors.
vista.compactaAviso: The compact card is one line: name, headcount and vacancies. The other card details are not shown.
vista.tarjeta: What to show on cards ({n} of {total})

resaltar.ayuda: Units that meet everything chosen are highlighted: the tag and, in their own positions, the rest. This adds to “Search unit or person”.

vistas.sinArbol: This branch is not saved in Trees. Save it there to have views of its own.
vistas.sinVistas: There are no saved views in this tree yet.

arbol.errorOrdenar: The diagram could not be arranged. Try “Rearrange”.

limite.texto: With more than {limite} cards in view the canvas gets slow. You can expand only some levels.

arbol.reordenarAyuda: Lays out the diagram again and fits it to the view

arboles.sinSubarboles: There are no saved subtrees yet.

directorio.buscar: Search by person, job title or email
directorio.vacio: There are no positions or people yet. Create units and positions in the tree.

revision.dias: {n} day without a holder | {n} days without a holder

sinJefatura.ayuda: Units with no head position, or whose position has no current holder or replacement.

vacantes.ayuda: Positions with no current holder, longest without a holder first.

reemplazos.ayuda: For information only: not counted in the menu counter.

sinPuesto.ayuda: Registered people who do not hold or replace any position today.

correos.ayuda: People who share the same email.

nombres.ayuda: The same name ignoring case and accents, or the same words in another order: possible duplicates.

vacias.ayuda: Units with no positions and no subunits.

sinUso.ayuda: Active values of the lists and active legends that nothing uses.

ayuda.noExiste: That help page does not exist.

errores.correoDuplicado: A person with that email already exists.
errores.etiquetaDuplicada: A tag with that name already exists.
errores.unidadYaEtiquetada: The unit already has that tag.
errores.valorDuplicado: That value already exists in the list.
errores.asignacionVigenteDuplicada: That position already has a current assignment of that type.
errores.fechasInvertidas: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
errores.conexionConsigoMisma: A unit cannot be connected to itself.
errores.relacionInexistente: The related unit or person no longer exists.
errores.ramaYaGuardada: That branch is already saved in Trees.
errores.vistaDuplicada: This tree already has a view with that name.
errores.colorInvalido: The color must use the #rrggbb format (for example, #be123c).
errores.desdeZip: BoldoAtlas is running from inside a .zip file ({ruta}). Close it, extract it to a folder first and open it from there; otherwise your data would end up in a temporary folder and be lost.
errores.esquemaNuevo: This database was created with a newer version of BoldoAtlas (schema {actual}; this app supports up to {conocida}). Update BoldoAtlas to open it.
errores.sinPermiso: BoldoAtlas can't write to {ruta}. Move it to a folder you have write access to (for example, Documents) or check that folder's permissions. Details: {detalle}
errores.translocado: macOS opened BoldoAtlas from a temporary read-only copy ({ruta}). If this is the portable version, remove the quarantine from its folder (xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine <folder>) and open it again; if you installed it from the .dmg, drag it to Applications and open it from there.
errores.sinAppdata: Your user data folder was not found.
errores.sinCarpeta: BoldoAtlas' data folder was not found.
errores.baseNoDisponible: The database is not available. Close BoldoAtlas and open it again.
errores.baseSoloLectura: The database is read-only: check that the boldo.db file and its folder are writable.

store.hayDatos: This database already has data: to replace it use “New empty organization” or “Explore the example” from the app menu.
store.cicloRama: A unit cannot be moved inside its own branch.
store.raizConContenido: The root unit cannot be deleted while it has content.
store.noSePuedeDeshacer: This can no longer be undone.
store.nadaQuePegar: There is no copied style that can be pasted.
store.ultimoTipoUnidad: At least one unit type must stay active.
store.soloLectura: You are viewing the org chart at a past date: it is read-only. Go back to today to change it.

ficha.descripcion: Changes are saved when you leave each field, if they are valid.

selector.buscar: Search or type a new value
selector.yaExistia: “{nombre}” was already in the list, so it was selected.

error.fotoTipo: The photo must be PNG, JPG or WebP.
error.fotoPeso: The photo cannot be larger than 1 MB.
error.fotoLectura: The photo could not be read.

ficha.sinGuardarTexto: A field is not valid or the record has not been created yet. If you discard, they will be lost.

puesto.sinPuestos: This unit has no positions yet.
puesto.sinHistorial: This position has no assignments yet.
puesto.cierraTitular: {nombre} will stop being the holder on {fecha}; they stay in the history.
puesto.yaEsTitular: That person is already the holder of this position: nothing changed.
puesto.sinGuardarTexto: The position hasn't been created yet. If you discard, what you entered will be lost.

unidad.sinColor: The mark has no color yet.
unidad.codigoLargo: The code allows up to 4 characters.
unidad.sinPuestosJefatura: No head: the unit has no positions. Create one with “New position…” in the list.
unidad.sinPuestosJefaturaSoloLectura: No head: the unit has no positions.
unidad.sinConexiones: This unit has no lateral connections.
unidad.eliminarTexto: It has {hijos} and {puestos}. They will move to “{superior}”. You can undo it for 8 seconds.
unidad.moverYEliminar: Move its content to “{superior}” and delete

personas.buscar: Search person, job title, unit or email
personas.sinCorreos: Nobody on the list has an email.
personas.nCubiertas: {n} covered by a replacement | {n} covered by a replacement

arbol.ayuda: Up and down arrows move, right and left open and close. Enter opens the person or selects the unit on the canvas; Shift+Enter opens the unit's head.

seleccion.eliminarTexto: What they contain (subunits and positions) will move to each one's parent unit. You can undo everything at once for 8 seconds.
seleccion.eliminarOmitidas: {n} root unit with content will not be deleted. | {n} root units with content will not be deleted.
seleccion.omitidas: {n} root unit with content was not deleted. | {n} root units with content were not deleted.

ubicar.verAyuda: Show in the org chart (Ctrl+click: in a new tab)
ubicar.noEsta: That position isn't in the org chart being shown. Check the date.

paleta.descripcion: Search units, people, vacant positions and actions.
paleta.ayudaVacia: Type to search units, people and vacant positions.
paleta.ayudaPestana: Ctrl+Enter or Ctrl+click: open units, people, their place in the org chart and views in a new tab.
paleta.mas: {n} more: keep typing to narrow down.

pestanas.limite: You can have up to {n} tabs open. Close one to open another.
pestanas.ultima: The last tab can't be closed.
pestanas.noAbre: That can't be opened in a tab.
pestanas.ayudaTeclado: Enter opens the tab, Delete closes it, Control+Shift+arrows move it.

vacia.texto: Start from scratch: you name the organization and its first unit.

excel.texto: Import the structure and the people from a spreadsheet.

boldo.texto: Continue with an organization saved in a file.

ejemplo.texto: A sample organization to try the app out.

bienvenida.hayDatos: This database already has data (“{nombre}”). Choosing an empty organization or the example replaces the current data; an automatic backup is made first.

reemplazarTitulo.vacia: Replace the current data with an empty organization?
reemplazarTitulo.ejemplo: Replace the current data with the example?

bienvenida.reemplazarTexto: The units, people, positions and other data of “{nombre}” will be deleted. An automatic backup is made first, and you can restore it from Settings › Backups.

inicio.ayuda: It opens minimized when you sign in, without taking focus from what you are doing. Closing the window quits it, as always.
inicio.portable: Not available in the portable version: it would store an entry outside its folder.
inicio.sistema: For now it is only available on Windows.
inicio.error: Could not change starting with the system: {detalle}

logo.ayuda: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 1 MB.

error.tipo: The file must be a PNG, JPG or WebP.
error.tamano: The image is larger than 1 MB.
error.lectura: The image could not be read.

apariencia.ayuda: These preferences apply to this computer only.

barra.abrirAlPasar: Open the sidebar on mouse hover

mantenedores.texto: Job titles, contract types, sites, schedules, unit types and legends.

respaldos.ayuda: Copies of your data in the backups folder on this computer. The 10 most recent backups are kept, automatic or manual.
respaldos.confirmarTexto: Your current data is backed up first (it appears in the list as “Before restore”). Then it is replaced with this backup and BoldoAtlas restarts.
respaldos.automaticoFallo: The automatic backup could not be made.

error.desconocido: That backup is no longer in the folder. Reopen Settings and try again.
error.danado: The backup is damaged or is not a BoldoAtlas database. Nothing was changed.
error.esquema_nuevo: This backup was made with a newer version of BoldoAtlas. Update BoldoAtlas to restore it.
error.en_uso: Another BoldoAtlas window is using the data. Close it and try again; nothing was changed.
error.fallo: The operation could not be completed: {detalle}

proyecto.errorCopiar: The path could not be copied: {detalle}

actualizar.versiones: You have version {actual}; the new one is {nueva}.
actualizar.sinNotas: This version has no notes here; you can read them on GitHub.

modo.instalador: The update will be downloaded and installed, and BoldoAtlas will restart.
modo.portable: BoldoAtlas will be replaced in this folder and restart; your data in datos/ is not touched.
modo.paquete: This copy was installed by the system (.deb or .rpm): download the new package and install it with your package manager.

error.red: Could not check: check your connection.
error.limite: GitHub is limiting requests for a while; try again later.
error.respuesta: GitHub sent an unexpected answer ({detalle}); try again later.
error.manifiesto: The published version has no valid package for this system; try again later. ({detalle})
error.firma: The download has no valid signature and was discarded; your current version is unchanged.
error.cancelada: Download cancelled; your current version is unchanged.
error.pendiente: The update is no longer available; check again.

error.version: Could not read the installed version ({detalle}).

actualizaciones.ayuda: BoldoAtlas looks for new versions by reading the public list of releases on GitHub: it is the only connection it makes on its own. It sends no organization data or identifiers, and never installs without asking you.

novedades.descripcion: What changed since the last version you used on this PC.
novedades.vacio: This copy has no release notes (it is a development or test build).
novedades.enEspanol: Release notes are written in Spanish.
novedades.historial: The notes of every version published up to this one.
